questions.question: Sami calls Mina: 'I have a cusp fracture on a molar! What to do?' Mina answers:
options: Assess the fracture and propose an onlay if possible
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'If the fracture is cuspidian without pulpal involvement, an onlay is a conservative solution.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will make an onlay.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a cavity under an inlay?' Mina advises him:
options: Assess the accessibility and size of the cavity
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'If the cavity is peripheral and accessible, a repair is possible.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will assess before deciding.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'When to use a flowable composite?' Mina answers him:
options: For small cavities or as a base layer
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Flowable composites are indicated for small cavities or as a base layer.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use flowable for small cavities.'

questions.question: Sami and Mina discuss restoration failures. Mina says: 'The most frequent cause is...'
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Failures are most often related to adhesion or sealing defects.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will control my adhesion.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to manage recurrent caries under a veneer?' Mina answers:
options: Repair if the cavity is small and accessible
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Small cavities under a veneer can be repaired without redoing the veneer.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will repair this veneer.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What is a devitalized tooth? How to restore it?' Mina answers him:
options: With an inlay-core if the structure is sufficient
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The inlay-core reinforces the devitalized tooth before the crown.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will make an inlay-core.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to manage a deep root cavity?' Mina advises him:
options: A glass ionomer or a composite with adhesion
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Glass ionomer is ideal for root cavities.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use glass ionomer.'

questions.question: Sami and Mina discuss onlays. Mina says: 'The onlay reinforces the tooth.' Sami asks: 'When is it indicated?'
options: For cusp fractures without pulpal involvement
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The onlay is indicated for conservable cuspal fractures.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will propose an onlay.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to manage a vertically fractured tooth?' Mina answers:
options: Assess the prognosis, often extraction if deep fracture
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Deep vertical fractures have a poor prognosis.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will assess the depth of the fracture.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to improve the aesthetics of an anterior composite?' Mina advises him:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Layering allows a natural aesthetic result.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will learn layering.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is a composite core?' Mina explains to him:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The composite core reconstructs the core of the tooth before the crown.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will make a composite core.'

questions.question: Sami and Mina discuss bonded bridges. Mina says: 'We can repair under a bridge.' Sami asks: 'When?'
options: If the cavity is accessible without removing the bridge
Only if the bridge is ceramic
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Accessible cavities under a bridge can be repaired.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will assess accessibility.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to manage a cavity under a temporary crown?' Mina answers:
options: Treat the cavity and redo the temporary crown
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The cavity under a temporary crown must be treated before placing the definitive crown.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will treat the cavity.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to choose between a composite and a ceramic?' Mina answers him:
options: The choice depends on the clinical situation
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The choice depends on the extent, location, and occlusal constraints.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will weigh the pros and cons.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to manage sensitivity after a composite?' Mina advises him:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Sensitivity is often related to an adhesion defect.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will check the sealing.'

questions.question: Sami and Mina discuss materials. Mina says: 'Glass ionomer releases fluoride.' Sami asks: 'Why is that important?'
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Fluoride release prevents recurrent caries.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use more glass ionomer.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to manage a tooth with a symptomatic crack?' Mina answers:
options: Restore if the crack is painful
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Symptomatic cracks require restoration.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will restore this crack.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'When to use a ceramic inlay rather than a composite one?' Mina answers him:
options: For extensive cavities with severe occlusion
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Ceramic is more resistant for extensive cavities.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use ceramic for this patient.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to manage a cavity under a removable prosthesis?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'If the cavity is accessible, it can be treated without redoing the prosthesis.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will treat this cavity.'

questions.question: Sami and Mina discuss composites. Mina says: 'Bulk-fill composites simplify life.' Sami asks: 'What is the risk of bulk-fill?'
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Bulk-fill can have higher shrinkage.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use them with caution.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to manage recurrent caries on a devitalized tooth?' Mina answers:
options: Treat the cavity and assess the need for a crown
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The cavity must be treated, and a crown is often indicated.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will treat and propose a crown.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to improve the retention of a composite?' Mina advises him:
options: Take care of the preparation and adhesion
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Retention depends on preparation and adhesion.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will take care of these two aspects.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'When to use a microhybrid composite?' Mina answers:
options: For posterior teeth with occlusal constraints
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Microhybrids are resistant for posterior teeth.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use a microhybrid for this molar.'

questions.question: Sami and Mina discuss CAD/CAM. Mina says: 'CAD/CAM allows one-session inlays.' Sami asks: 'What is the disadvantage?'
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'CAD/CAM has a high investment cost.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will evaluate the profitability of CAD/CAM.'

questions.question: Sami, after facing complex cases with Mina, says: 'I am proud of our successes!' Mina concludes: 'Advanced techniques are...'
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Advanced techniques are the key to saving teeth.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will continue to perfect myself.'
